display_name: 45. 추론 시 정확한 관측 일치 사영
phase: 0 (no training): exact observation-consistency projection applied only at inference to experiment 43 weights

models.main: C2 (original + W2 parallel capacity, no normalization)

operator.D: common/observation.SensorObservation('QB', 'decimate', phase=(2, 2)): DLPan MTF FIR 41 taps per band, replicate boundary, x4 decimation; audited in experiment 3 (train interior RMSE 2.2e-13 DN)
operator.adjoint: exact adjoint of D by automatic differentiation
operator.projection: y' = argmin ||y' - y||^2 s.t. M D y' = M MS  =>  y' = y + D^T M^T lambda, (M D D^T M^T) lambda = M (MS - D y)
operator.solver: conjugate gradient per band, FP32 tensors, relative residual 1e-6, at most 300 iterations; iterations and final observation residual recorded

variants.P5: M = MS-grid interior with a 5-pixel border excluded (as the experiment 3 audit) - main

operator.units: DN/2047 inputs and outputs, metrics on DN, no clipping

checks_before_metrics: RR test: interior and border RMSE of D(GT) - MS (data consistency of the constraint)
base (no projection) means reproduce the archived experiment 43 evaluation

gate.main_C2: 3-seed mean of (C2+P5 - C2): D_s <= -0.03 AND PSNR >= -0.15 dB -> pass (supports a capacity + exact observation layer design)
gate.large_candidate: 3-seed mean C2+P5 vs C0 base: PSNR >= +0.3 dB AND provisional QNR >= -0.005 -> flag as large-improvement candidate
gate.context: C0, C1, C3 with P5 and P0, and C2 with P0, are reported without separate gates
